IRS990.ActivityOrMissionDesc: Charity Navigator's mission is to make impactful giving easier for all.
IRS990.MissionDesc: Charity Navigator aims to make impactful giving easier for all by providing free, accessible information, ratings, guidance, and tools for donors. Charity Navigator democratizes philanthropy, allows donors of every wealth segment to feel confident in their giving decisions, and highlights organizations doing important work worldwide.
IRS990.Desc: Charity Ratings - Charity Navigator aims to make impactful giving easier for all.Since 2001, it has been empowering millions of donors by providing them free access to data, tools, and resources to guide philanthropic decision-making. The ratings provide nonprofits with the sector's premier trust indicator and a powerful platform to raise awareness and funds.As of June 30, 2025, Charity Navigator's database includes more than 1.6 million U.S. registered nonprofits, with over 242,561 nonprofits evaluated through the Encompass Rating System. The Encompass Rating System, launched in July 2020, provides donors with comprehensive evaluations of the total impact of nonprofits rated via four Beacons: Finance & Accountability (242,119), Impact & Measurement (7,925), Leadership & Adaptability (13,305), and Culture & Community (19,387). In 2024, Charity Navigator created or updated more than 50 curated lists of recommended charities, leveraging its deep expertise in assessing charity performance. These lists cover a broad range of issues, from responses to crises to specific cause-based recommendations, helping donors find organizations aligned with their values.Additionally, in the Fall of 2024, Charity Navigator launched Causeway, an innovative new offering. Causeway features collections of highly effective, top-rated charities focused on driving significant change for particular issues. These collections include dedicated funds addressing major challenges such as global poverty, climate change, hunger, and homelessness.More than 8 million donors accessing Charity Navigator each year give with confidence, knowing which organizations are highly rated, trustworthy, and impactful. While the organization has a large footprint and an established, trusted brand, the team of approximately 40 considers itself small but mighty.Between July 1, 2024 and June 30, 2025, site visitors donated $50,000,000+ to over 26,000 nonprofits through Charity Navigator's Giving Basket.Like the nonprofits it rates, Charity Navigator is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit, too. It doesn't charge the organizations it evaluates, ensuring its ratings remain objective. In turn, it depends on the generosity of individuals, foundations, and corporations to fund its programs.

SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: The Organization is a tax-exempt organization as defined by Section 501(c)(3) of the Internal Revenue Code, though it is subject to tax on income unrelated to its exempt purpose, unless that income is otherwise excluded by the Code. The Organization has processes presently in place to ensure the maintenance of its tax-exempt status; to identify and report unrelated income; to determine its filing and tax obligations in jurisdictions for which it has nexus; and to identify and evaluate other matters that may be considered tax positions. The Organization has determined that there are no material uncertain tax positions that require recognition or disclosure in the financial statements.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: Form 990, Part VI, Section B, line 11b
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: Leadership conducts a review of the Form 990 before submitting it to the full Board for review and then to the IRS.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: Form 990, Part VI, Section B, line 12c
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: All board and staff complete and sign the Conflict-of-Interest policy on an annual basis in order to update and disclose their affiliations.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: Form 990, Part VI, Section B, line 15
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: The board's executive/compensation committee conducts a review of the President & CEO's performance to determine if a pay increase is warranted and if so, how much.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: Form 990, Part VI, Section C, line 19
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: Charity Navigator's financial documents (audited financials and Form 990's) and policies (Compensation philosophy, Conflict of interest policy, record retention & document destruction policy, whistleblower policy) are accessible on its website. Documents are also provided to anyone making a request in person or in writing.
The Organization did not change either its oversight process or selection process during the tax year.
